text: {"lessons":["Selling winners early can limit further gains; I should base decisions on each stock’s prospects, not just its gain versus my average cost.","Buying back a stock after selling it can undo the benefit of a disciplined plan; I should reassess its outlook and position size before trading again.","Holding a declining stock and selling only after a steep loss can compound the damage; I should review holdings regularly and set clear reasons for when to keep or exit."]}
